compatibility.note: Core spec_version remains 0.1 and the normative Core files are unchanged from v0.2.0.
The historical catch-all root barrel was narrowed to the stable API. Inspector/runtime/research imports moved to the explicit ./experimental subpath.
The reference package remains private; npm publication is not part of v0.3.0.
init-example, human validation, explain, and conformance commands are additive; existing validate JSON output remains the default.
The action interface remains advisory and compatible; internal Inspector imports now use the experimental package entrypoint.
Conformance Corpus Report and Implementer Feedback Corpus are new independently versioned non-Core contracts.

non_blocking_gaps: The TypeScript package remains private and unpublished.
The implementer feedback corpus remains evidence_status=hypothesis until real curated observations arrive.
Go and Rust reference implementations remain future work.
Some Inspector/runtime/research APIs remain explicitly experimental.
